Radi stimuliranja proizvodnje energije iz obnovljivih izvora, a kako bi ona postala konkurentnija energiji dobivenoj iz konvencionalnih izvora, te poticanja izgradnje novih izvora obnovljive energije i postizanja održivog razvoja, naručitelj je odredio da električna energija mora sadržavati gore navedeni minimalni postotak električne energije iz obnovljivih izvora. Kao potvrdu ispunjenja uvjeta o podrijetlu električne energije, odabrani ponuditelj (Opskrbljivač) je obvezan po izvršenoj isporuci električne energije dostaviti Naručitelju važeću potvrdu iz Registra jamstava podrijetla električne energije, izdanu od strane neovisnog tijela za izdavanje jamstva porijekla električne energije, kojom se potvrđuje da je količina - postotni udio električne energije naveden u ponudi odabranog ponuditelja, isporučene električne energije proizvedeno iz obnovljivih izvora energije.Predmetni certifikat odabrani ponuditelj (Opskrbljivač) dužan je predati Naručitelju sukladno Metodologiji utvrđivanja podrijetla električne energije (NN 133/14, 127/19) članak 19. U slučaju nedostavljanja tražene potvrde, odnosno u slučaju da dostavljenom potvrdom odabrani ponuditelj (Opskrbljivač) ne dokaže da je postotni udio, naveden u ponudi odabranog ponuditelja, isporučene električne energije proizveden iz obnovljivih izvora energije, navedeno postupanje smatrat će se povredom ugovornih obveza, temeljem čega Naručitelj zadržava pravo aktiviranja jamstva za uredno ispunjenje ugovora te poduzimanja daljnjih aktivnosti sukladno drugim pozitivnim propisima koji reguliraju predmetno područje. Tijelo nadležno za izdavanje jamstava porijekla električne energije u Republici Hrvatskoj je Hrvatski operator tržišta energije d.o.o. (HROTE).Po isteku ugovora odabrani ponuditelj će dostaviti odgovarajuću potvrdu iz Registra jamstava podrijetla električne energije ili druge dokaze sukladno propisima kojima se uređuje sustav jamstva podrijetla električne energije; kako bi potvrdio koliki je udio električne energije kojom je opskrbljivao naručitelja podrijetlom iz obnovljivih izvora.

title: Croatia – Restoration work – Cjelovita obnova zgrade „Škola“ u Gradu mladih Granešina
description: Cjelovita obnova zgrade Škola u Gradu mladih koja je potrebna nakon što je Grad Zagreb pogodio potres 22.3.2020. Izrađena je projektna dokumentacija (glavni i izvedbeni projekti, troškovnici radova) cjelovite obnove zgrade Škola (ukupne bruto površine 1388 m2) koja je stradala u potresu i temeljem statičkog pregleda dobila temeljem oznaku „privremeno neupotrebljiva“. Kako se u Gradu mladih provodi program jednodnevnih izleta Škola u šumi (sufinanciran od strane Grada Zagreba, namijenjeno uzrastu od 1.-4. razreda osnovne škole) kao i programe za vrtićku djecu, nužno je obnoviti predmetni objekt „ŠKOLA“ kako bi se mogao prihvatiti veći broj korisnika. Naime, za vrijeme lošeg i hladnog vremena, koristila se „ŠKOLA“ za realizaciju programa koji se inače provodi na otvorenom prostoru, budući da u tom objektu može istovremeno boraviti 240 djece. Međutim, ako je najava lošeg vremena, ravnateljice škola Grada ZG uglavnom otkazuju dolazak na izlet, odnosno program Škola u šumi, čime se gubi značajan dio prihoda. Izrađen je Konzervatorski elaborat obnove zgrade Paviljona 29 „Škola“ Grada Mladih te Glavni i Izvedbeni projekti za cjelovitu obnovu objekta: - Arhitektonski projekt - Projekt konstrukcije-statički proračun - Projekt Vodovod i odvodnja - Strojarski projekt - Elektrotehnički projekt - Projekt vatrodojave - Zaštita od požara - Zaštita od buke - Racionalna uporaba energije i toplinska zaštita Potrebno je angažirati stručni nadzor i koordinatora II ZNR te voditelja projekta. Naručitelj će navedeno nabaviti u zasebnom postupku nabave. Izvođač radova dužan je osigurati osobu za izvođenje neophodnih konzervatorsko - restauratorskih radova sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o uvjetima za dobivanje dopuštenja za obavljanje poslova na zaštiti i očuvanju kulturnih dobara (Narodne novine 104/2025).

title: Germany – General management consultancy services – 10035189-Advice on implementation of AfCFTA Digital Trade Protocol and technical inputs to related reforms; facilitation and development of partnerships with the private sector on digital trade
description: The project "Pan-African e-Commerce Initiative 3 - Boosting African Digital Trade" (PeCI 3) is a regional technical cooperation project implemented by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) in the context of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). The project aims to strengthen an enabling environment for cross-border digital trade in Africa, with a particular focus on micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs), including women-led businesses. PeCI 3 contributes to the BMZ"s core area "Sustainable Economic Development, Training and Employment" and supports it"s digital policy and Africa Strategy through the promotion of inclusive digital trade ecosystems, and public-private cooperation. The project builds on the achievements and partnerships established under the previous phases (PeCI 1 and PeCI 2). Earlier phases supported MSMEs in adopting e-commerce solutions and digital sales channels, strengthened intermediary organisations providing training and advisory services, facilitated public-private exchange on digital trade issues and contributed to regional approaches related to e-commerce, digital payments, consumer protection and electronic transactions. The project also strengthened cooperation with the East African Community (EAC), the Smart Africa Alliance (SAA) and the AfCFTA Secretariat. PeCI 3 supports implementation of the AfCFTA Digital Trade Protocol (DTP), adopted by the African Union in 2024, by strengthening structures, processes and cooperation mechanisms required for cross-border digital trade. The project addresses barriers affecting MSME participation in digital trade, including fragmented regulatory frameworks, limited interoperability of digital payment systems, logistics and last-mile delivery challenges, gaps in online consumer protection and limited coordination between public and private actors. Particular attention is given to barriers affecting women"s participation in digital trade ecosystems. The project operates at pan-African, regional and national levels and combines technical advisory services, stakeholder consultations, public-private dialogue formats and capacity development measures. Activities include support for implementation of selected DTP chapters, facilitation of cross-border exchange on best practices, development of cooperation models between private-sector actors and intermediary organisations, and support for gender-sensitive approaches to digital entrepreneurship and MSME support services. Environmental sustainability is integrated as a cross-cutting topic, including approaches related to sustainable packaging and resource-efficient logistics. The project is implemented in cooperation with public, private and regional stakeholders in selected AfCFTA countries, particularly Ghana and Kenya, as well as with the EAC. Lead executing agencies are the Ministry of Finance in Ghana, the Ministry of Investments, Trade and Industry (MITI) in Kenya and the EAC Secretariat. Additional partners include the AfCFTA Secretariat, the Smart Africa Secretariat, chambers of commerce, business and e-commerce associations, payment service providers, logistics companies, innovation hubs and women"s business networks. PeCI 3 further aims to strengthen cooperation between African, German and European private-sector actors to promote cross-border digital trade and MSME participation. The project cooperates with business associations, e-commerce platforms, logistics and payment providers, chambers of commerce and innovation actors, including bevh, AHKs and African e-commerce associations. Cooperation with UNCTAD, ITC and initiatives supported by the European Union and the World Bank further strengthens synergies and regional outreach. The project is scheduled to run until June 2028.

Gegenstand der Beauftragung sind Leistungen für Inbetriebnahmemanagement und technisches Monitoring. Diese erfolgen für Planungs- (Generalplaner) und Bauleistungen (Totalunternehmer) bis zur Fertigstellung der Maßnahme nach Abschluss der Einregulierungsphase. Die Planung erfolgt durch einen GP mit dem Leistungsspektrum: Objektplanung: Gebäude, Freianlagen, Ingenieurbauwerke, Fachplanung: Technische Ausrüstung (KG 410-480), Tragwerksplanung Gebäude und Ingenieurbauwerke, Bauphysik: Bauakustik, Raumakustik, Wärmeschutz und Energiebilanzierung, BIM Management, Brandschutz, Übergeordnete besondere Leistungen, sowie Qualitätssicherung / Begleitung Totalunternehmer. Der Generalplaner übernimmt die Leistungsphasen 1-4 gemäß HOAI. Er liefert grundlegende Aspekte der Leistungsphase 5. Anschließend beginnt der Totalunternehmer mit der Ausführungsplanung und erbringt die Leistungsphasen 5 bis 8. Das Projekt befindet sich derzeit in der Leistungsphase 2. Das Rechenzentrum erfüllt die Verfügbarkeitsklasse VK3 mit redundanter Versorgung sowie weiterer Sicherheitsanforderungen und soll abschnittsweise in Betrieb genommen werden. Neben höchsten Standards an Energieeffizienz und Nachhaltigkeit wird ein Zielwert von ≤ 1,2 PUE sowie die Verifizierbarkeit Blauer Engel vorgegeben. Die Arbeitsmethode BIM, das BIM Management durch den PS, kommt zum Einsatz zur präzisen Abstimmung aller Beteiligten, zur Koordination von Daten und Leistungen und zur Entwicklung zukunftssicherer Lösungen. Das Gebäude unterliegt dem BSI-Schutzbedarf „hoch“. Besondere Anforderungen berücksichtigen die Erschütterungsempfindlichkeit, hochwasserangepasstes Bauen sowie den Schutz gegen äußere Einflüsse wie Spreng- oder Anpralllasten. Die Kostenobergrenze für die Baumaßnahme beträgt 240.000.000 Euro brutto. Die genannten Kosten umfassen die Kostengruppen 200 bis 600 nach DIN 276-1:2018-12. Die Kosten für die Kostengruppe 400 betragen 114.500.000 € brutto. Mit dem Neubau stärkt der Freistaat Bayern seine digitale Infrastruktur und setzt Maßstäbe in puncto Sicherheit, Nachhaltigkeit und technologischer Innovation.

title: DC Power Supply
description: SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory is operated by Stanford University for the Department of Energy. As a management and operating contractor, subcontracts awarded by the Laboratory are not Federal procurements, and are not directly subject to the Federal Acquisition Regulations in 48 CFR. Nonetheless, certain Federal laws, Executive Orders, and regulations may affect our DOE approved purchasing system, as required by statute, regulation, or contract terms and conditions. Please review the requirements and provide your best and final offer for both price and lead-time. The following has been attached for you to complete and review: (BAA) Buy American Act Certification Representations & Certifications Rider Confirm attached SLAC Terms and Conditions are accepted Technical Specifications Requested for Quote: Modular, remotely controllable DC power supply system for detector electronics Quantity: 1 EA Please provide a price and lead time quotation by Monday, November 30, 2026. Technical Evaluation Factors Listed Below: Ability to Meet the Technical Requirements: The Offeror�s proposal and supporting technical documentation will be evaluated to confirm compliance with the required detector power-supply specifications listed below. Schedule and Delivery Date: The University will evaluate the proposed lead time and delivery schedule against SLAC�s required project schedule. An acceptable lead time is within 30 weeks after issuance of the purchase order. Past Performance: The University may evaluate documentation demonstrating prior manufacturing and delivery of similar or comparable equipment. Offerors with no relevant past or present performance history may receive an �Unknown Confidence� rating. Required item(s) are listed below: Modular, remotely controllable DC power supply system for detector electronics Quantity: 1 EA Technical Requirements: Provide stable, low-noise, programmable DC power over at least the 30�60 VDC range. Support detector loads requiring up to 13.5 A and approximately 650 W per required output or load group. Support multiple independently controllable outputs, with the final number of outputs determined by the detector configuration and support for up to 16 outputs where applicable. Outputs shall be electrically isolated/potential-free where required by the detector grounding scheme. Provide programmable voltage and current limits, ramp rates, trip thresholds, temperature protection, and configurable fault behavior, including individual-channel and grouped-channel shutdown where needed to protect detector electronics. Output noise and ripple shall be sufficiently low for sensitive detector operation. Vendors shall provide guaranteed ripple and noise specifications with measurement conditions. Ethernet-based remote monitoring and control are required, including readback of voltage, current, status, fault state, and temperature or over-temperature status. A local service/configuration interface is required. Web interface and SNMP support are specifically required for SLAC controls integration. The system shall be air-cooled, protected against over-temperature conditions, and suitable for continuous operation at rated load in the intended SLAC installation environment. Operate from SLAC-compatible AC mains power, nominally 100�240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, with appropriate power factor correction and compliance with applicable electrical safety and EMC standards. The system shall be compatible with standard SLAC rack or detector support installations. Standard 19-inch rack mounting is required if installed in existing SLAC racks. A compact form factor, such as 3U height or less and approximately 450 mm depth or less, is preferred unless the final installation envelope requires these limits. Vendors shall provide mechanical dimensions, weight, cooling requirements, power input requirements, output connector details, isolation ratings, safety certifications, and remote-control interface documentation. Redundant output capability, master-slave or parallel operation for current boosting, extended floating voltage capability, browser-based configuration, SNMP support, and modular field-serviceable architecture are required by the detector configuration. Source Selection: Source selection will be conducted using the Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) method. Award will be made to the responsible Offeror submitting the lowest-priced offer that is determined technically acceptable in accordance with the stated evaluation factors. Please provide a price and lead time quotation by Monday, November 30, 2026. Is there any room for additional discount such as for Academic, ICPT, GSA, or Government Institutions? Buy American Act Certification (BAA) applies as applicable to this procurement. Representations & Certifications Rider is required. Once completed, the Reps and Certs is valid for one year until renewal. If you have already completed one within the year, please disregard. Otherwise, please complete and return. Please include in your proposal the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS Code) and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN), if applicable. Please identify any applicable tariffs, duties, or other import-related charges as separate line items in your quotation. All subcontractors are required to register in the System for Award Management (SAM.gov). If possible, please provide a link to your webpage for a published price list or other information to substantiate the prices quoted. The resulting purchase order will be issued on a fixed-price basis. SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory Terms and Conditions for Fixed Price Commercial Supplies and Services, as well as any applicable supplemental rider, will be made a part of the resulting order. Please markup the terms and conditions if you wish to negotiate. No markups mean that you accept SLAC Terms and Conditions. Payment Terms will be NET-30. Domestic Suppliers: Freight terms will be FOB Destination Prepaid and Add. Foreign Suppliers: Shipment will be made CIP SLAC, Menlo Park, and Duty Unpaid. You are requested to mark and identify proprietary/confidential information provided in response to the solicitation. Please submit your quotation by Monday, November 30, 2026. description: The intent of this notice is to identify potential offerors for market research purposes. The Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC) Far East, Resident Officer in Charge of Construction (ROICC) Sasebo, is currently seeking interested contractors who are willing and qualified to provide to perform Custodial Services at Commander Fleet Activities, Sasebo (CFAS), Japan. The Government is contemplating a multiple year (one year base period and seven one-year option periods) ordering period, single award Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) type performance based service contract comprised of Recurring Work and Non-Recurring Work Items. PWS for the contemplated renewal IDIQ(s) is still under development, but will be substantially similar. The Government is contemplating issuing a Commercial solicitation in accordance with FAR Part 12.The Government intends to issue the solicitation as an Invitation for Bids (IFB) in accordance with (IAW) FAR 14 or Request for Proposal (RFP) IAW FAR 15. If you are capable of and interested in performing this requirement, please complete and submit Questions Comments and Market Research: Contractor Information. Please provide any comments/recommendations/questions in this form. The response will be used as market research to help determine the acquisition method utilized by the Government for this requirement. In order to be eligible for any U.S. Government award, a contractor must register in the System for Award Management at www.sam.gov and have a valid CAGE code. Interested contractors are encouraged to begin the registration process as soon as possible. Please submit the information to Hirokazu Toyofuku, Contract Specialist via e-mail at hirokazu.toyofuku.ln@us.navy.mil no later than 10:00 am on 30 November 2026, using the subject line Sources Sought Custodial Services at CFAS, Japan. title: Poland – Electric buses – Dostawa 5 fabrycznie nowych, niskopodłogowych autobusów miejskich o napędzie elektrycznym
description: Przedmiotem zamówienia jest dostawa do siedziby miejskiej spółki 5 fabrycznie nowych niskopodłogowych autobusów 12m o napędzie elektrycznym. Miejsce realizacji przedmiotu zamówienia: Luboń, ul. Przemysłowa 13/15. Oferowane autobusy mają być nowe. Przedmiotem zamówienia objęte są również następujące świadczenia Wykonawcy: a) udzielenie Zamawiającemu, przez Wykonawcę autoryzacji na wykonywanie prac obsługowo-naprawczych oferowanego typu autobusu wraz z przeszkoleniem pracowników Zamawiającego w zakresie bieżącej obsługi i napraw autobusów, dostarczenia wyposażenia elektronicznego (dedykowanych urządzeń i systemów), wyposażenia dodatkowego w związku z udzieloną autoryzacją, w tym oprzyrządowania, aparatury diagnostycznej, narzędzi specjalistycznych niezbędnych do wykonywania obsługi technicznej i napraw gwarancyjnych autobusów, a także oprogramowania (pełnych licencji), udzielenie Zamawiającemu przez Wykonawcę gwarancji. Szczegółowy opis jest w SWZ. 1. Projekt składany do dofinansowania w ramach FENIKS 3.1. Działanie: FENX.03.01 Transport miejski – autobusy i trolejbusy Program: Fundusze Europejskie na Infrastrukturę, Klimat, Środowisko 2021-2027. Zamówienie ma być finansowanie z funduszy Unii Europejskiej. 2. Postępowanie jest prowadzone zgodnie z zasadami przewidzianymi dla tzw. ,,procedury odwróconej’’ o której mowa w art. 139 Pzp. Zgodnie z ta regulacja Zamawiający najpierw dokona badania i oceny ofert a następnie dokona kwalifikacji podmiotowej Wykonawcy, którego oferta została najwyżej oceniona, w zakresie braku podstaw wykluczenia oraz spełnienia warunków udziału w postepowaniu. 3. Zamawiający wykorzystuje uprawnienie z art. 393 ust. 1 pkt. 4 Pzp. Zamawiający wymaga, aby w przedmiocie dostawy udział towarów, w tym oprogramowania wykorzystywanego w wyposażeniu sieci telekomunikacyjnych pochodzących z państw członkowskich Unii Europejskiej, państw, z którymi Unia Europejska zawarła umowy o równym traktowaniu przedsiębiorców, lub państw, wobec których na mocy decyzji Rady stosuje się przepisy dyrektywy 2014/25/UE, przekraczał 50%. Zamawiający wymaga złożenia oświadczenia w tym zakresie w Formularzu Ofertowym (Załącznik nr 2 do SWZ). Zgodnie z art. 393 ust. 1 ppkt. 4 ustawy Pzp, Zamawiający odrzuci ofertę, w której udział towarów, w tym oprogramowania wykorzystywanego w wyposażeniu sieci telekomunikacyjnych pochodzących z państw członkowskich Unii Europejskiej, państw, z którymi Unia Europejska zawarła umowy o równym traktowaniu przedsiębiorców, lub państw wobec których na mocy decyzji Rady stosuje się przepisy dyrektywy 2014/25/UE nie przekracza 50% 4. Zamawiający w postępowaniu o udzielenie zamówienia publicznego korzysta z uprawnienia do ograniczenia dostępu do zamówień Wykonawcom z państw trzecich, z którymi Unia Europejska nie jest związana żadną umową międzynarodową gwarantującą na zasadzie wzajemności i równości dostęp do rynku zamówień publicznych. Περιλαμβάνει την επικαιροποίηση και συμπλήρωση της εγκεκριμένης Οριστικής μελέτης, την εκπόνηση της Μελέτης Εφαρμογής και την πλήρη κατασκευή του ΚΠΕΕ και του περιβάλλοντος χώρου αυτού, σύμφωνα με τις Τεχνικές Προδιαγραφές και τα λοιπά Συμβατικά Τεύχη. Το Κτίριο Διοίκησης – Λειτουργική Ενότητα Κέντρου Περιβαλλοντικής Ευαισθητοποίησης και Ενημέρωσης (ΚΠΕΕ) θα κατασκευαστεί στο Β.Δ. τμήμα του γηπέδου του ΚΕΛ σε οικοπεδική έκταση περίπου 23.000 m2. Θα έχει πολυχρηστικό χαρακτήρα και θα φιλοξενεί χρήσεις που έχουν πολιτιστική και κοινωνική χροιά. Το Τρίτο Τμήμα του Έργου θεωρείται ότι περατώθηκε επιτυχώς μετά την πλήρη κατασκευή όλων των προβλεπόμενων έργων και την επιτυχή εκτέλεση όλων των δοκιμασιών και ελέγχων που ορίζονται στα Συμβατικά Τεύχη (δοκιμές περαίωσης και δοκιμές ολοκλήρωσης) Β. Δεύτερο Μέρος (Μέρος 2) του Έργου. Περιλαμβάνει την κανονική λειτουργία και συντήρηση του ΚΕΛ και του υποθαλάσσιου αγωγού από τον Ανάδοχο για λογαριασμό της ΕΥΔΑΠ, καθώς και τη συντήρηση του Κέντρου Περιβαλλοντικής Ευαισθητοποίησης και Ενημέρωσης και του περιβάλλοντος αυτού χώρου, για χρονικό διάστημα επτά (7) ετών ή ογδόντα τεσσάρων (84) μηνών, με δικαίωμα προαίρεσης για ένα (1) επιπλέον έτος. Κατά την διάρκεια της Κανονικής Λειτουργίας και Συντήρησης, ο Ανάδοχος θα έχει την πλήρη και αποκλειστική ευθύνη για την επίτευξη των απαιτούμενων αποδόσεων επεξεργασίας όσον αφορά τις τελικές εκροές και την επεξεργασμένη ιλύ, οι οποίες πρέπει να είναι σύμφωνες με τα όσα καθορίζονται στο παρόν τεύχος καθώς και με τις εγγυήσεις που έχει υποβάλλει μαζί με την Τεχνική Προσφορά του. Το Δεύτερο Μέρος του Έργου θεωρείται ότι περατώθηκε επιτυχώς μετά την παρέλευση του συμβατικού χρόνου από την σχετική εντολή της ΕΥΔΑΠ, την ολοκλήρωση όλων των ελέγχων και την εκπλήρωση όλων των υποχρεώσεων από πλευράς Αναδόχου και την υπογραφή σχετικού πρωτοκόλλου, όπως αυτά ορίζονται στα Συμβατικά Τεύχη. Όλα τα ανωτέρω έργα θα μελετηθούν και θα εκτελεστούν σύμφωνα με όσα ορίζονται στα Συμβατικά Στοιχεία της Εργολαβίας. Ειδικότερα στο αντικείμενο της εργολαβίας περιλαμβάνονται και η εκπόνηση κάθε είδους μελέτης και υποστηρικτικής εργασίας – έρευνας που είναι αναγκαία για την άρτια κατασκευή των έργων (ΚΕΛ, υποθαλάσσιος αγωγός, ΚΠΕΕ). Eνδεικτικά και όχι περιοριστικά αναφέρονται παρακάτω: - Η Οριστική Μελέτη – Μελέτη Εφαρμογής των έργων της Α1 Φάσης των εγκαταστάσεων του ΚΕΛ Ραφήνας – Πικερμίου και Σπάτων – Αρτέμιδας και του υποθαλάσσιου τμήματος του αγωγού διάθεσης εκροών (έχει ήδη εκπονηθεί η Προμελέτη) - Η Μελέτη Εφαρμογής του Κέντρου Περιβαλλοντικής Ευαισθητοποίησης και Ενημέρωσης (ΚΠΕΕ) (έχει ήδη εκπονηθεί η οριστική Αρχιτεκτονική και Στατική Μελέτη και η προμελέτη Η/Μ εγκαταστάσεων). - Η έρευνα βυθού και γεωτεχνική έρευνα - μελέτη στην περιοχή πόντισης του υποθαλάσσιου αγωγού - Η μελέτη HAZOP για τις εγκαταστάσεις του ΚΕΛ - Το ΣΑΥ και ο ΦΑΥ του Έργου - Η επικαιροποίηση των υφιστάμενων περιβαλλοντικών μελετών και η εκπόνηση νέων ή συμπληρωματικών εφόσον απαιτείται - Η έκδοση των πάσης φύσεως αδειών για την κατασκευή και λειτουργία - Η σύνταξη των εγχειριδίων Λειτουργίας και Συντήρησης - Η σύνταξη από τον Ανάδοχο των απαιτούμενων από την σύμβαση στοιχείων που αφορούν στη Λειτουργία και Συντήρηση των έργων - Η σύνταξη του μητρώου του Έργου

description: Предметът на обществената поръчка: обхваща доставка, инсталиране и интеграция в информационната система на БНР на съвременни системи, решения и софтуери в областта на информационната сигурност, съпътстващо хардуерно оборудване, необходимо за използване в системите, свързване на отделните компоненти и въвеждане в експлоатация на интегрирана модулна платформа за създаване на оперативен център за киберсигурност на Българското национално радио, както и обучение на персонала и гаранционна поддръжка на системата. Оперативният център за киберсигурност е предназначен за осигуряване на висока степен на защита от посегателства към мрежата на БНР и крайните точки (сървъри и работни станции). Интегрираната платформа следва да включва следните хардуерни и софтуерни компоненти: -Централизирана платформа за събиране, анализ и корелация на информацията (SOC); -Мрежови защитни стени от ново поколение; -Система за откриване и реакция на заплахи посредством анализ на мрежовия трафик; -Система защита на идентичности; -Система за управление на привилегирования достъп; - Система за контрол на достъп; -Система за Корпоративен Браузър с цел защитена работа с web, облачни и AI услуги; -Система за управление на уязвимостите; - Система за защита на електронна поща; -Система за киберустойчивост, архивиране и възстановяване; -Платформа за разузнавателна информация за киберзаплахи; -Съпътстващо хардуерно оборудване, необходимо за използване в системите: 1200 бр. хардуерни устройства (токени) за устойчива многофактурна автентикация; 8 броя специализирани физически устройства за системата за анализ на мрежовия трафик; 5 бр. специализирани операторски работни станции. Към момента на откриване на настоящата обществена поръчка не е осигурено финансиране. В тази връзка процедурата се открива при условията на чл. 114 от ЗОП. Изпълнението на договора започва само след осигуряване на финансов ресурс от страна на Възложителя и отправяне на изрично писмено уведомление до Изпълнителя. Общият срок за изпълнение на дейностите от предмета на поръчката (доставка, инсталиране, интеграция и обучение) е до 10 (десет) месеца. Срокът започва да тече след осигуряване от Възложителя на финансов ресурс и предоставяне на писмено уведомление по реда на чл. 114 от ЗОП. Дейностите по договора се осъществяват последователно в следните етапи: Етап 1 (Доставка): Срокът за доставка на хардуерното оборудване и софтуерните лицензи е не повече от 3 (три) месеца, считано от датата на потвърждение от Възложителя за осигурено финансиране за тази обществена поръчка и представена гаранция за изпълнение от Изпълнителя. Етап 2 (Инсталация и интеграция): Срокът за изпълнение на услугите по инсталация и интеграция е не повече от 6 (шест) месеца, считано от датата на подписване на двустранен приемо-предавателен протокол за доставка на хардуерното оборудване и софтуера. Етап 3 (обучение на администратори и потребители: Срокът за изпълнение на дейностите по обучение е не повече от 1 (един) месец, считано от датата на подписване на приемо-предавателен протокол за инсталация и интеграция. Срокът на гаранционната поддръжката е не по-кратък от 36 (тридесет и шест) месеца, считано от датата на подписване на окончателен приемо-предавателен протокол за въвеждането в експлоатация на интегрираната модулна платформа за създаване на оперативен център за киберсигурност в нейната цялост. ​​​​​​​Тази обществена поръчка се провежда при условията на чл. 114 от ЗОП. В тази връзка и на основание чл. 114, ал. 1 от ЗОП, договорът за възлагане на изпълнението на обществената поръчка ще се счита за възложен под отлагателно условие – с клауза за отложено изпълнение, което ще се осъществи само при осигурено финансиране. ​​​​​​​

Доставките се извършват до посочения във всяка конкретна заявка административен адрес на територията на град Пловдив Количествата, посочени в Техническите спецификации, са прогнозни, за срока на действие на договора. Възложителят запазва правото си, съобразно възникналите потребности, да не заяви или да заяви в по-малък или по-голям обем отделни прогнозни количества, до достигане на максималната стойност на Договора или до изтичане на срока на договора, в зависимост от това кое обстоятелство настъпи първо. Условията, при които ще се реализира предметът на поръчката, както и правата и задълженията на Възложителя и на изпълнителя, са съгласно Проекта на договор, Техническата спецификация на Възложителя, Техническото и Ценово предложения на Изпълнителя ОП 1 – неразделна част от Документацията. Договорът, който ще бъде сключен с участника, определен за изпълнител на поръчката, влиза в сила от датата на регистрирането му в деловодната система на ВЪЗЛОЖИТЕЛЯ и е със срок на действие до изпълнение на задълженията по Договора или до достигане на максималната му стойност, което от двете събития настъпи по-рано, но за не повече от 12 (дванадесет) месеца. Предвижда се договора за ОП 1 да бъде еднократно подновен при същите условия, включително срок, обем и обща стойност, при условията, посочени в проекта на договор. Заплащането на доставените стоки се извършва по банков път, в срока и при условията, определени в Проекта на договор, след представяне на фактура от Изпълнителя, въз основа на действително доставените и приети количества по единичните цени, определени съгласно Протоколите по т. 2 и т. 3 от Техническата спецификация. Във връзка с изискванията на чл. 47а от ЗОП, стоките от предмета на обществената поръчка са група з) печива по смисъла на § 1. от ДР на Закона за храните, и не са включени в Списъка на биологични хранителни продукти по Приложение № 1 към чл. 4 от Наредба № Н-1 от 23.07.2024 г. за екологичните изисквания към определени продукти, предмет на обществени поръчки.

description: Mesto Liptovský Mikuláš realizuje projekt „Smart život a služby v meste Liptovský Mikuláš“, ktorý predstavuje kľúčovú iniciatívu na vytvorenie Integračnej platformy služieb (IPS) ako centrálneho piliera digitálneho riadenia mesta. Projekt reaguje na roztrieštenosť dát v oddelených systémoch a absenciu jednotného digitálneho kanála pre obyvateľov. Cieľom je prepojenie mestských služieb, organizácií a obyvateľov do jednotného digitálneho prostredia. Predmetom zákazky je dodanie, implementácia a integrácia komplexného súboru softvérových, aplikačných a technologických riešení, vrátane hardvérových komponentov, ktoré umožnia mestu Liptovský Mikuláš vybudovať Integračnú platformu služieb (IPS) a poskytovať digitálne služby obyvateľom. Riešenie bude zahŕňať: – Integračná platforma služieb (IPS) – centrálne jadro pre zber, správu, spracovanie, prepájanie dát a analytiku – Modul Systém správy verejnej dopravy – evidencia zastávok, vozidiel, cestovných oprávnení – Modul Obslužný systém – centrálna evidencia vstupov, rezervácií, kapacít a vyťaženosti mestských prevádzok – Modul Správa mobilnej aplikácie – CMS nástroj na správu obsahu, štruktúry a dizajnu mobilnej aplikácie bez zásahu do kódu – Mobilná aplikácia obyvateľa – natívna iOS/Android aplikácia s Kontom obyvateľa (IAM), komunitami, podnetmi, anketami, participatívnym rozpočtom – Modul Systém správy dát a informácií úradu – CMS pre portál mesta vrátane 10 elektronických formulárov životných situácií (z toho 5 najpoužívanejších e-formulárov životných situácií integrovaných s ÚPVS) – Modul Webový portál mesta – responzívny frontend s Kontom obyvateľa, elektronickými formulármi a životnými situáciami – Modul Web pre návštevníkov – samostatný turistický portál s interaktívnou mapou, atrakciami, AI prekladom a rezervačnými integráciami – IoT zariadenia – LoRaWAN sieť (brány), senzory počítania ľudí (PIR/LoRaWAN), vstupný turniket (nerezový trojramenný), digitálne úradné tabule – Integrácia a API – REST API, OpenAPI 3.0, Open Data na data.gov.sk, napojenie na CoraGeo, Park Dots, OOCR Liptov, ÚPVS, MIRRI analytická vrstva Podrobný opis predmetu zákazky tvorí prílohu č. 3 SP.

title: eFOIA
description: The Air Force is seeking innovative commercial solutions to modernize, streamline, and replace its legacy Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) infrastructure. This Call is issued under the authority of the overarching Department of the Air Force (DAF) Program Acquisition Executive (PAE) Business and Enterprise Systems (BES) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) to identify, evaluate, and acquire an Electronic FOIA (eFOIA) Technology System capable of managing the absolute end-to-end lifecycle of a FOIA request. The objective of this Call is to pilot and scale a secure, cloud-native implementation with the ability to host in Cloud One (Government hosted) and carry out a highly automated software solution that dramatically reduces backlog, speeds up response times, ensures strict compliance with ever-changing federal regulations including a secure cyber posture, and provides an intuitive interface for both agency personnel and public requesters.

title: Tactical Resupply Unmanned Aircraft System Increment II Cargo UAS Industry Demonstration
description: Synopsis The Direct Reporting Portfolio Manager for Robotic and Autonomous Systems (DRPM RAS) 4.0, Air Warfare Program Management Office (DRPM RAS 4.0 Air Warfare PMO), Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland, desires to accelerate the identification of unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and enabling technologies, prototyping integration, and fielding evaluation of potential solutions for the Marine Corps Unmanned Logistics System � Air (ULS-A) logistics distribution mission. During the weeks of 25 January through 5 February 2027, Air Warfare PMO will sponsor a technology demonstration in Huntsville, Alabama. The Government requests applications from industry to participate in this demonstration; successful performance during the demonstration may subsequently result in the award of an Other Transaction (OT) Prototype Agreement in accordance with 10 U.S.C. � 4022. Announcement Information TRUAS Increment II is intended to provide an organic aerial distribution capability for small-unit logistics support across the last tactical mile in Expeditionary Advanced Base Operations and Distributed Operations. To encourage broad demonstration participation and identify the full spectrum of commercial innovation, the Government invites submissions from all qualified participants, including non-traditional defense contractors and small businesses, whose applications satisfy the minimum threshold requirements, specifically, preference of a Max Gross Take Off Weight (MGTOW) up to 350 lbs and Key Performance Parameter (KPP) 1 � Operational Performance and KPP 5 - Powerplant and Energy Source. See Table 1. The Government reserves the right to select any, all, or none of the applicants for participation in the demonstration. Participants will be required to demonstrate ground set-up and flight preparation procedures for their UAS, perform refueling demonstration, and perform up to five autonomous flights. During the first flight, participating UAS must fly with a 100 lb payload a total of 40 nautical miles (nm), detach the payload (either manually or automatically), fly a return flight of 40 nm with no payload, and land at the original launch site. During the second flight, participating UAS must fly with a minimum 150 lb payload a total of 10 nm, detach the payload (either manually or automatically), fly a return flight 10 nm with no payload, and land at the original launch site. The UAS must complete each required flight without refueling. Following the two required flights, participants may be given the opportunity to perform up to three additional flights to demonstrate unique features and/or capabilities, subject to Government approval. The UAS must transit at an airspeed no less than 50 knots and an altitude no greater than 1,000 feet above ground level (AGL). The UAS must be capable of launching and recovering without a catapult, arresting net or cable, or other mechanical launch or recovery equipment. Participants shall ensure that their UAS is equipped with a transponder with a minimum of a Mode-3/C capability. Participants, as part of their application, will be required to provide the Government with lost-link/return-to-home procedures to support range safety requirements. Participants will also be required to provide the Government with technical information to support coordination for frequency spectrum authorization, and Government facility access, if required. Participants must provide data that validates the maximum theoretical range of their UAS with 100 lb and 150 lb payloads. The Government, with assistance of contracted support personnel, will coordinate demonstration range set-up and provide coordination assistance for airworthiness certification and frequency allocation as required. The Government may award an OT prototype agreement to the participant(s) whose UAS capability demonstrate the most advantageous combination of the KPP and Key System Attributes (KSA) requirements outlined in Table 1 and Table 2. To be considered for the demonstration, UAS capabilities must meet threshold minimum requirements for KPP 1 and KPP 5. During evaluation for potential OT award, the Government will prioritize capabilities that achieve KPP and KSA threshold and objective requirements. Government Evaluators will record performance data for each participant�s flight demonstrations. UAS will be ranked based on demonstrated ability to achieve threshold and objective requirements. The Government intends to select the highest-ranked UAS capability(ies) that offer the most advantageous utility to the Marine Corps logistical mission for potential OT prototype awards. The Government reserves the right to consider partial solutions addressing a subset of the requirements and retains the flexibility to make an award even if not all KPP and KSA thresholds and objectives are fully met, provided the proposed solution successfully satisfies the Marine Corps logistical mission. The Government reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to award zero, one, or multiple OTs following this demonstration event. Selection to participate in the demonstration does not guarantee an OT award. Selectees will be required to join the Naval Aviation Systems Consortium (NASC) in order to be eligible to receive an OT award; more information is available at www.nascsolutions.org. In accordance with 10 U.S.C. � 4022, a successfully completed prototype project may result in the award of a follow-on production agreement or contract without further competition. In addition to the primary consideration for an OT prototype agreement, the Government will analyze flight performance data and, upon request, may share these results with the Army-managed Drones.Mil Marketplace team. The marketplace provides a streamlined, pre-vetted pathway for other Department of War (DoW) and allied partners to procure platforms. Interested and eligible applicants must submit a 3-5 page white paper that describes their technical approach and the technical maturity of their UAS together with the completed questionnaire found at https://nascsolutions.org/project/truas-increment-ii-cargo-uas-industry-demonstration/. There are no NASC Membership requirements and no associated fees required with the application submission or to participate in this demonstration. Applications will be scored in accordance with the TRUAS Increment II Application Evaluation Rubric, which is available for download at https://nascsolutions.org/project/truas-increment-ii-cargo-uas-industry-demonstration/. To ensure an eligible score for demonstration selection, applicants are encouraged to review this rubric and address eligibility criterion within their white paper and/or questionnaire response. Applications for participation will be submitted to nascopportunities@nascsolutions.tech and accepted until 2359 EST on 30 November 2026. The Government may, but is not required to, seek clarifications or additional information from applicants regarding their application. Notification to selected participant(s) will be issued via e-mail no later than 2359 EST on 18 December 2026; information regarding the demonstration venue will be provided within selection email. Submit technical questions to nascopportunities@nascsolutions.tech by 13 November 2026. Technical questions and answers related to the demonstration will be posted and updated on https://nascsolutions.org/project/truas-increment-ii-cargo-uas-industry-demonstration/. See attached announcement, TRUAS Increment II Demonstration Announcement, for full details related to this demonstration and its associated attachments.

During the first flight, participating UAS must fly with a 100 lb payload a total of 40 nautical miles (nm), detach the payload (either manually or automatically), fly a return flight of 40 nm with no payload, and land at the original launch site. During the second flight, participating UAS must fly with a minimum 150 lb payload a total of 10 nm, detach the payload (either manually or automatically), fly a return flight 10 nm with no payload, and land at the original launch site. The UAS must complete each required flight without refueling. Following the two required flights, participants may be given the opportunity to perform up to three additional flights to demonstrate unique features and/or capabilities, subject to Government approval. The UAS must transit at an airspeed no less than 50 knots and an altitude no greater than 1,000 feet above ground level (AGL). The UAS must be capable of launching and recovering without a catapult, arresting net or cable, or other mechanical launch or recovery equipment. Participants shall ensure that their UAS is equipped with a transponder with a minimum of a Mode-3/C capability. Participants, as part of their application, will be required to provide the Government with lost-link/return-to-home procedures to support range safety requirements. Participants will also be required to provide the Government with technical information to support coordination for frequency spectrum authorization, and Government facility access, if required. Participants must provide data that validates the maximum theoretical range of their UAS with 100 lb and 150 lb payloads. The Government, with assistance of contracted support personnel, will coordinate demonstration range set-up and provide coordination assistance for airworthiness certification and frequency allocation as required. The Government may award an OT prototype agreement to the participant(s) whose UAS capability demonstrate the most advantageous combination of the KPP and Key System Attributes (KSA) requirements outlined in Table 1 and Table 2. To be considered for the demonstration, UAS capabilities must meet threshold minimum requirements for KPP 1 and KPP 5. During evaluation for potential OT award, the Government will prioritize capabilities that achieve KPP and KSA threshold and objective requirements. Government Evaluators will record performance data for each participant�s flight demonstrations. UAS will be ranked based on demonstrated ability to achieve threshold and objective requirements. The Government intends to select the highest-ranked UAS capability(ies) that offer the most advantageous utility to the Marine Corps logistical mission for potential OT prototype awards. The Government reserves the right to consider partial solutions addressing a subset of the requirements and retains the flexibility to make an award even if not all KPP and KSA thresholds and objectives are fully met, provided the proposed solution successfully satisfies the Marine Corps logistical mission. The Government reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to award zero, one, or multiple OTs following this demonstration event. Selection to participate in the demonstration does not guarantee an OT award. Selectees will be required to join the Naval Aviation Systems Consortium (NASC) in order to be eligible to receive an OT award; more information is available at www.nascsolutions.org. In accordance with 10 U.S.C. � 4022, a successfully completed prototype project may result in the award of a follow-on production agreement or contract without further competition. In addition to the primary consideration for an OT prototype agreement, the Government will analyze flight performance data and, upon request, may share these results with the Army-managed Drones.Mil Marketplace team. The marketplace provides a streamlined, pre-vetted pathway for other Department of War (DoW) and allied partners to procure platforms. Interested and eligible applicants must submit a 3-5 page white paper that describes their technical approach and the technical maturity of their UAS together with the completed questionnaire found at https://nascsolutions.org/project/truas-increment-ii-cargo-uas-industry-demonstration/. There are no NASC Membership requirements and no associated fees required with the application submission or to participate in this demonstration. Applications will be scored in accordance with the TRUAS Increment II Application Evaluation Rubric, which is available for download at https://nascsolutions.org/project/truas-increment-ii-cargo-uas-industry-demonstration/. To ensure an eligible score for demonstration selection, applicants are encouraged to review this rubric and address eligibility criterion within their white paper and/or questionnaire response. Applications for participation will be submitted to nascopportunities@nascsolutions.tech and accepted until 2359 EST on 30 November 2026. The Government may, but is not required to, seek clarifications or additional information from applicants regarding their application. Notification to selected participant(s) will be issued via e-mail no later than 2359 EST on 18 December 2026; information regarding the demonstration venue will be provided within selection email. Submit technical questions to nascopportunities@nascsolutions.tech by 13 November 2026. Technical questions and answers related to the demonstration will be posted and updated on https://nascsolutions.org/project/truas-increment-ii-cargo-uas-industry-demonstration/. title: Nákup služby – poskytnutí palivových odběrových karet na pohonné hmoty s následným nákupem pohonných hmot u civilních čerpacích stanic v letech 2027 a 2028
description: Předmětem VZMR je zabezpečení doplňování automobilové techniky Vojenského historického ústavu Praha pohonnými hmotami prostřednictvím palivových odběrových karet dodavatele služby na území ČR v předpokládaném množství cca 35 000 l pohonných hmot za rok (dále jen „služba“). Pohonné hmoty budou odebírány prostřednictvím odběrových míst (čerpacích stanic) sjednaných dodavatelem v rozsahu benzín automobilový, nafta motorová (dále jen „zboží“), dle platných jakostních specifikací pro příslušné druhy odebíraného zboží. Převzetí zboží bude probíhat na odběrových místech sjednaných dodavatelem a bude provedeno na základě vystavené palivové odběrové karty mezi zástupcem objednatele (řidič) a zástupcem dodavatele (odběrové místo/čerpací stanice). Řidič musí obdržet doklad o prodeji. Náklady pro zabezpečení provozu palivových odběrových karet (provozní poplatek, případně poplatek za použití karty) budou účtovány dle platného sazebníku dodavatele vyplývajícího z cenové nabídky, nebudou součástí ceny zboží a budou zahrnovat veškeré náklady dodavatele spojené s využitím palivových odběrových karet (např. náklady na fakturaci, poštovné, apod.). Fakturovaná cena zboží bude aktuální cenou odběrového místa/čerpací stanice v dané chvíli odběru, která je zveřejněna na stojanu odběrového místa/čerpací stanice. Fakturaci, s podrobným rozpisem použití palivové odběrové karty provádět do 10. dne kalendářního měsíce vždy za předchozí kalendářní měsíc. V případě doručení faktury po 10. 12. 2028 je splatnost faktury stanovena na 60 dnů ode dne jejího doručení. Fakturu-daňový doklad doručit objednateli (držitelem poštovní licence, elektronicky nebo osobně) nejpozději do 10. dne v měsíci za předchozí kalendářní měsíc. Splatnost řádně vystavené faktury-daňového dokladu je 30 dní od doručení objednateli. Obsah faktury-daňového dokladu – viz návrh Smlouvy. Požadujeme: - poskytnutí (vydání a dodání) 7 palivových odběrových karet a jejich používání nezávisle na četnosti použití do stanoveného limitu denního a měsíčního odběru v Kč (viz příloha č. 2 Smlouvy), - provozování karet bez nutnosti finančního zajištění (nebudou placeny žádné zálohy), - alfanumerické rozlišení každé karty, zabezpečení PIN kódem, možnost stanovení denního a měsíčního limitu odběru v Kč, - akceptaci karet minimálně u tří společností s plošným pokrytím v ČR, - jako přílohu nabídky požadujeme zaslat seznam odběrových míst (čerpacích stanic) na území Hlavního města Prahy a Středočeského kraje, na kterých budou karty akceptovány, - na vyžádání poskytnout technickou a jakostní dokumentaci o poskytovaném zboží v českém jazyce, - vystavení faktury-daňového dokladu s podrobným rozpisem použití palivových odběrových karet, - zajistit, aby platební terminály byly funkční na čerpacích stanicích PHM sjednaných dodavatelem. K této nabídce podávané v rámci VZMR musí být připojeny a vyplněny přílohy „Návrh Smlouvy o poskytnutí služby“ včetně přílohy č. 1 „Závazná cenová nabídka – poskytnutí palivových odběrových karet na pohonné hmoty v letech 2027 a 2028“. Doba a místo plnění veřejné zakázky Od 1.1.2027 do 31.12.2028 Místo pro dodání palivových odběrových karet: Vojenský historický ústav Praha, U Památníku 2, 130 05 Praha 3 – Žižkov (GPS: 50°5´14.454´´N, 14°26´41.933´´E). Místo plnění veřejné zakázky: Čerpací stanice PHM na území ČR. Další požadavky na kvalifikaci - Výpis z obchodního rejstříku (nebo ŽR, SKD, SCD). - Seznam čerpacích stanic na území Hlavního města Prahy a Středočeského kraje. Kritéria hodnocení Zadavatel bude hodnotit pouze nabídku dodavatelů, které splňují kvalifikační požadavky uvedené v souboru Závazná cenová nabídka. Zadavatel zvolil kritériem hodnocení ekonomická výhodnost nabídky. Podrobnosti kritérií hodnocení Základní hodnotící kritérium: Ekonomická výhodnost nabídky Způsob hodnocení: Mimo systém. Sestavení pořadí při stejném pořadí nabídek: Jiný způsob Při stejném pořadí bude vyhlášeno druhé kolo výběrového řízení Stanovení hodnotících krité

title: Halle (Saale), Frau-von-Selmnitz-Straße 6, 360-Dachkonstruktionen, -öffnungen, -beläge
description: Dachkonstruktionen Bei dem Bauvorhaben handelt es sich um die Ertüchtigung der bestehenden Dachkonstruktionen der Häuser 3 bis 6 der Agentur für Arbeit Halle. Grundlage dervorgesehenen Arbeiten bilden die durchgeführten Bestandsuntersuchungen sowie die statischen Stellungnahmen zur Tragfähigkeit der vorhandenen Dachkonstruktionen. Die vorhandenen Dachkonstruktionen wurden im Rahmen einer Ortsbegehung am 20.02.2024 untersucht. Nach den vorliegenden statischen Stellungnahmen ist die Standsicherheit der Dachkonstruktionen nach den allgemein anerkannten Regeln der Technik grundsätzlich nicht eingeschränkt. In den durch Windsog besonders beanspruchten Eck- und Randbereichen sind jedoch Ertüchtigungsmaßnahmen zur Wiederherstellung der Gebrauchstauglichkeit vorgesehen. Die Arbeiten umfassen insbesondere die temporäre Aufnahme bzw. den Rückbau der vorhandenen Stehfalzblecheindeckung, die Ertüchtigung vorhandener Holz-Holz-Verbindungen und weiterer konstruktiver Anschlusspunkte, die Nachbefestigung der vorhandenen Dachschalung sowie anschließend die fachgerechte Wiederherstellung bzw. Neueindeckung der betreffenden Dachflächen. Für die Häuser 3 bis 5 ist nach der statischen Stellungnahme unter anderem die Nachbefestigung der Fußhölzer im Bestandsmauerwerk vorgesehen. Die Häuser 3 bis 6 stehen unter Denkmalschutz. Sämtliche Arbeiten sind daher unter besonderer Berücksichtigung der denkmalgeschützten Bausubstanz auszuführen. Eingriffe in die bestehende Konstruktion und in das äußere Erscheinungsbild sind auf das technisch notwendige Maß zu beschränken. Vorhandene, erhaltenswerte Bauteile und Konstruktionen sind während der Arbeiten besonders zu schützen. Die Ausführung der Arbeiten hat entsprechend den Vorgaben und Abstimmungen mit dem Auftraggeber und, soweit erforderlich, der zuständigen Denkmalschutzbehörde zu erfolgen. Insbesondere beim Rückbau und bei der Wiederherstellung der vorhandenen Dachdeckung ist auf eine dem Bestand und dem denkmalgeschützten Erscheinungsbild entsprechende Ausführung zu achten.

title: Laboratoriotason kylmälaitteet humaaninäytteiden, verituotteiden ja reagenssien säilytykseen
description: Hankinnan kohteena ovat Fimlab Laboratoriot Oy:n käyttöön tulevat laboratoriotason kylmälaitteet (Laitteet) humaaninäytteiden, verituotteiden ja reagenssien säilytykseen. Hankintaan sisältyy toimitus, asennus, käyttöönotto, tuki- ja huoltopalvelut sekä laitteisiin liittyvät tarvikkeet ja lisävarusteet tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä kuvatuin ehdoin. Laitteiden huolto- ja tukipalveluista tehdään erillinen sopimus. Hankinta on jaettu kuuteen osaan laitetyypittäin; laboratoriotason jääkaappi, laboratoriotason jääkaappi-pakastin, laboratoriotason pakastin, syväjääpakastin, verijääkaappi laboratoriokäyttöön ja verikeskustason plasmapakastimet. Kukin osa sisältää 1 - 4 osa-aluetta, jotka on muodostettu laitteen koon, ominaisuuden tai muun eriävän käyttötarkoituksen perusteella. Kuhunkin osa-alueeseen valitaan kaksi eri kauppanimeä (laitemallia), edellyttäen että hyväksyttyjä tarjouksia on riittävästi. Tarjoaja voi jättää yhden tarjouksen. Osatarjoukset ovat sallittuja sekä osien että osa-alueiden välillä. Tarjoaja voi tarjota kuhunkin tarjoamaansa osa-alueeseen yhtä tai enintään kahta eri kauppanimeä (laitemallia) ns. rinnakkaistarjouksena. Hintaliitteellä on arvio laitteiden hankintamääristä sopimuskaudella. Hankittavia Laitteita on eri tyyppisiä ja niitä hankitaan Tilaajan tarpeen mukaan (uusiin tarpeisiin ja nykyisten laitteiden tilalle niiden poistuttua käytöstä) pääosin Tilaajan toiminta-alueen tuotantolaboratorioihin (Tampere, Hämeenlinna, Jyväskylä, Lahti, Vaasa) ja satunnaisesti suurimpiin näytteenottokeskuksiin. Hankittava laitemäärä on arvio eikä se sido Tilaajaa. Toteutuvat hankintamäärät voivat olla siis arvioitua suurempia tai pienempiä. Hankinnalla pyritään varmistamaan laadukkaiden, turvallisten ja toimintavarmojen kylmälaitteiden saatavuus Fimlabin eri yksiköiden tarpeisiin kilpailukykyisin ehdoin. Laitteita koskeva sopimuskausi on kaksi vuotta. Sopimusta on mahdollista jatkaa yhdellä kahden (2) vuoden pituisella optiokaudella. Tuki- ja huoltopalveluista tehdään erillinen neljän vuoden pituinen sopimus. Huoltosopimusta on mahdollista jatkaa neljän vuoden sopimuskauden jälkeen toistaiseksi voimassaolevana., B. title: Finland – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Asianhallintaratkaisun hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on Kanta-Hämeen hyvinvointialueen (Oma Häme) asianhallinnan selainpohjainen kokonaisratkaisu SaaS-palveluna, järjestelmän tuki- ja ylläpitopalvelut sekä järjestelmän käyttöönottoprojekti. Ratkaisun tulee olla valmis, välittömästi käyttöön otettavissa oleva ilman merkittäviä räätälöintejä toteutettava sähköisen asianhallinnan kokonaisratkaisu. Tarvittavat jatkokehitys- ja asiantuntijapalvelut tilataan erikseen. Kilpailutuksen tavoitteena on hankkia ajantasainen tiedonhallintaa koskevan lainsäädännön ja suositusten mukainen asianhallintaratkaisu. Ratkaisun tulee tukea sujuvaa tiedonhallinnan työtä ollen käyttöliittymältään mukautuva ja helppokäyttöinen. Tavoitteena on löytää sekä teknisesti että palvelun näkökulmasta valmis kokonaisratkaisu. Hankinnan kohteena olevan asianhallintaratkaisun tulee sisältää vähintään seuraavat järjestelmän toiminnallisuudet ja osat: • tiedonohjaus • asianhallinta ja asiakirjahallinta • työkulkujen hallinta • viranhaltijapäätösten valmistelu päätöksenteko • toimielinten kokousaineistojen tuottaminen ja hallinta sekä sähköinen kokous • hyväksymistasoinen allekirjoitus viranhaltijapäätöksille • vahva sähköinen allekirjoitus järjestelmään kuuluvana tai integraationa kolmannen osapuolen sähköisen allekirjoituksen järjestelmään • toimielinten kokousaineistojen ja viranhaltijapäätösten julkaisu internetiin • yhteystietorekisteri / luottamushenkilörekisteri • sidonnaisuusilmoituksien käsittelyn ja julkaisuun mahdollistava toiminnallisuus • Suomi.fi -viestit • Suomi.fi -tunnistautumispalvelu • sähköinen arkisto Tarjotun järjestelmän tulee toimia käyttöliittymältään vähintään suomeksi. Järjestelmässä tulee olla huomioituna saavutettavuus teknisillä apuvälineillä sekä järjestelmän käyttöliittymässä mutta myös julkaistavissa päätöksissä. Järjestelmän käyttäjiin kuuluvat pääkäyttäjät, kirjaajat, arkistonhoitajat, käsittelijät, päätösten valmistelijat, viranhaltijat (päätöksentekijät), kokousjärjestelijät sekä luottamushenkilöt. Järjestelmän tulee olla avoimiin standardeihin perustuva ja järjestelmäriippumaton, mahdollistaen identiteettitunnistautumisen (esim. title: Notice of Intent To Award Sole Source WHOI REMUS Support
description: The Naval Undersea Warfare Center Division, Newport (NUWCDIVNPT) intends to award, on a sole-source basis under the statutory authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1) as implemented by FAR 6.103-1, a Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF) and Cost Only, Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity type contract to Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution (WHOI), CAGE Code 88846, Woods Hole, MA. This requirement is to provide research, development, engineering, and technical services to support NUWCDIVNPT in developing, assessing, upgrading, modernizing, and deploying the Navy Remote Environmental Measuring Units (REMUS) Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (AUV) systems and advanced undersea communication subsystems across all classes of submarines and surface ships. Tasking includes evaluation of system hardware, firmware and software of the REMUS, as well as design analysis and assessment of prototype systems to meet system, operation and platform requirements. It is anticipated that 113,000 man-hours will be required over the five-year ordering period. The NAICS Code is 541715, and the size standard is 1,000 employees. WHOI is the sole designer, original developer, and proprietor of the core technologies embedded within the REMUS 600 and REMUS 3000 AUV platforms. WHOI developed, implemented, and owns proprietary rights and source code for the undersea acoustic and optical communications architectures operating across submarines, surface vessels, buoys, off-hull transponders, divers, and unmanned vehicles. Additionally, WHOI implemented dual-layered, National Security Agency (NSA)-approved encryption software embedded in these systems, requiring specialized and proprietary codebase access to maintain deployment compliance under Navy Authority to Operate (ATO), Interconnect Security Agreements, and Posture Transition Procedures. This requirement to any other contractor would be technically infeasible and cost-prohibitive, resulting in substantial duplication of costs not expected to be recovered through competition. Furthermore, awarding to another source would create an unacceptable delay of three to five years while awaiting redesign, fabrication, testing, and safety/security recertification of submarine-compatible vehicles, causing an untenable mission gap for fleet undersea operations. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. A Competitive solicitation will not be issued. All responsible sources may submit a capability statement, proposal, or quotation which shall be considered by the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed procurement based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Further details will be released upon issuance of solicitation# N6660427RB700, which is anticipated to be released in December 2026. Information or inquiries should be submitted via email to the primary point of contact: John.a.keech3.civ@us.navy.mil

title: 31100PR270000005 - USCG BASE LA - LB Building #25 Smoke Detector Removal and Replacement Service
description: Requesting Agency: United States Coast Guard Base Los Angeles Long Beach, San Pedro, CA 90731 Project: Base Smoke Detectors Removal & Replacement BLDG 25 Solicitation Evaluation: Trade-Off (FAR 15.101-1(b)) DETAILS: The United States Coast Guard (USCG) is issuing a solicitation for the removal and replacement of existing smoke detectors in Building 25 at Base Los Angeles Long Beach. The contractor shall provide all necessary labor, materials, equipment, and supervision to safely remove existing units and install approximately 110 new, compatible smoke detectors and base mounts. The project also requires comprehensive testing and fire alarm panel programming to ensure full, integrated system functionality. EVALUATION AND AWARD: The Government will award a firm-fixed-price contract to the responsible offeror whose proposal is most advantageous to the Government. All evaluation factors other than cost or price, when combined, are significantly more important than cost or price. To be considered for award, offerors must submit documented evidence of direct experience. Proposals must include at least two (2) examples of direct experience installing commercial smoke detectors or fire alarm systems, performed within the last two (2) years. The Government will evaluate the relevance, scope, and complexity of the submitted past experience to determine the most advantageous offer. All proposals must also include a full breakdown of labor and materials to demonstrate a clear understanding of the technical requirements. NOTE TO OFFERORS: The attached Scope of Work (SOW) provides the technical specifications for the project, but it is only one part of the complete solicitation package. All required elements, terms, conditions, and explicit instructions for proposal submission are contained within this primary solicitation description. Offerors must review the entire package thoroughly. Relying solely on the SOW will result in an incomplete proposal. WALK THROUGH & QUESTIONS: For site visits and technical questions please contact: Mr. Eric Martincavage (Eric.L.Martincavage@uscg.mil) or 510.866.6022. Site visits are Optional. All technical questions must be submitted via email no later than Monday, November 23, 2026 at 2:00 PM Pacific Time. SUBMISSION OF PROPOSALS: All proposals will be submitted by e-mail to the Contracting Officer: Mr. Ryan H. King (ryan.h.king2@uscg.mil). All proposals are due by Monday, Novemeber 30, 2026 by 11:59pm Pacific Time. Late proposals will not be accepted.

title: Neubau HIPSII.2
description: Das neue Gebäude entsteht auf dem Campus der Universität des Saarlandes in Saarbrücken und wird durch das Helmholtz-Institut genutzt. Es handelt sich um einen Erweiterungsbau für den ersten Bauabschnitt des Helmholtz-Instituts für Pharmazeutische Forschung Saarland (HIPS) und ergänzt diesen funktional wie architektonisch. Der Erweiterungsbau ist östlich des Bestandsgebäudes geplant und mit dem Bestand durch zwei Brücken verbunden, die je den Büro- und Laborflur mit dem des Neubaus verbinden. Ergänzt wird der Erweiterungsbau durch östlich gelegene im Gelände eingebundene terassierte Parkflächen. Die Längsachsen des Gebäudes orientieren sich in ihrer Lage am Bestand. Das Laborachsraster wurde etwas weiter als im Bestand gewählt um letztlich eine flexiblere Geräteaufstellung zu erlauben. Dadurch entsteht für die Büros und Labore ein einheitliches, auf einem 1,2m Grundmaß basierendes Raster, das zur Vereinfachung der Konstruktion beiträgt. Der Neubau ist als viergeschossiges Gebäude mit einem zusätzlichen Staffelgeschoss und einer Gesamthöhe von ca. 22 m geplant. Das Baufeld liegt in Hanglage. Es ist im Erdgeschoss ebenerdig vom Garten aus zugänglich. Der Hauptzugang erfolgt im ersten Obergeschoss vom Straßenniveau aus. Das Gebäude besteht aus einem in den Hang gesetztes Erdgeschoss sowie 4 Obergeschossen, wobei das 4. OG als Staffelgeschoss ausgebildet ist. In diesem befindet sich hälftig die Technikzentrale sowie einem großen Sozialraum inkl. Dachterrasse. Außenabmessungen: ca. 66,00 x 33,00 m Die terrassierte Parkflächen bestehen im wesentlichen aus drei versetzten Parkebenen, welche über eine seitlich gelegene Zufahrt erschlossen werden (Ebene 1: 3 St Behindertenparkplätze / Ebene 2: 24 St Parkplätze / Ebene 3: 12 St Parkplätze). Gegenstand der Ausschreibung sind die Rohbauarbeiten für den Neubau des Forschungs- und Laborgebäudes. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst die Baustelleneinrichtung, Erd-, Gründungs-, Stahlbeton-, Mauerwerks-, Abdichtungs- und Dämmarbeiten einschließlich der erforderlichen Entwässerungs- und Einbauteile im Rohbau. Weiterhin beinhaltet die Leistung die Herstellung der wasserundurchlässigen Baukonstruktion (Weiße Wanne), Fertigteil- und Verbundbauteile sowie alle zugehörigen Schutz-, Sicherungs- und Nebenleistungen. Verlegung Ring,- und Fundamenterder inkl. Betoneinbauten. Ausbau Grundleitungen in und unter der Bodenplatte. Ausbau von Gebäude Einführungen der TGA-Gewerke. ***Auftrag steht in Verbindung mit einem Vorhaben und/oder Programm, das aus Mitteln des Europäischen Fonds für Regionale Entwicklung (EFRE) finanziert wird.***

title: Los 2.2: Tragwerksplanung inkl. Planung Bauphysik Grundleistungen der Tragwerksplanung, Leistungsbild nach HOAI §51, sowie die Grundleistungen der Bauphysik, Leistungsbild nach HOAI-Anlage 1.2, sowie optionale besondere Leistungen.
description: Die ENTEGA AG („Auftraggeber“ oder „AG“) ist Eigentümerin und Betreiberin des Fernwärmenetzes im Darmstädter Stadtteil Eberstadt und des dort ansässigen Heizkraftwerks, von wo aus die Haushalte des Fernwärmesatzungsgebietes und die wenigen Anschlüsse außerhalb des Satzungsgebietes versorgt werden. Ebenso ist die ENTEGA Abwasserreinigung GmbH & Co. KG die Betreiberin des Klärwerks Süd in Eberstadt. Für die Transformation des Fernwärmenetzes hin zu einer treibhausgasneutralen Wärmeversorgung (Dekarbonisierung) strebt der AG die Erlangung von Fördermitteln aus dem Fördermittelprogramm „Bundesförderung für effiziente Wärmenetze (BEW)“ an. Als erster Schritt zur Dekarbonisierung wurde bereits mit Fördermitteln aus dem BEW Modul I eine Transformationsplanung angelehnt an die LPH 1 der HOAI für das Fernwärmenetz durchgeführt. Die Transformationsplanung kommt zu dem Ergebnis, dass die thermische Nutzung von Abwasser mittels einer Wärmepumpenanlage an der Kläranlage in Eberstadt eine kosteneffiziente und geeignete Option darstellen kann, den geforderten Erneuerbaren Energien Anteil ab 2030 bereitzustellen. Das abgeschätzte nutzbare Wärmepotential, welches mittels Wärmepumpen aus dem anfallendem Klärwasser gehoben werden kann, liegt bei nahezu 20 GWh pro Jahr bei einer thermischen Nennleistung der Wärmepumpe von ca. 3 MWth. Die Wärmepumpe soll in der Nähe des örtlichen Klärwerks auf einem noch zu erschließenden Flurstück platziert werden. Die Erschließung des Flurstücks als Baugrundstück wird von dem gesondert vom AG mit der Objektplanung beauftragten Architekten geplant. Die Planung der Abwasserwärme in diesem Bereich mitsamt Anbindung/Einbindung der Wärmepumpe in das Fernwärmenetz gehört mit zur vorliegenden Beauftragung. Erste Prüfungen zur Eignung des Standortes führen zu dem vorläufigen Ergebnis, dass eine entsprechende Bebauung des Flurstücks möglich ist. Weitere Prüfungen müssen in den Planungsphasen entsprechend ihrer Relevanz und der behördlichen Vorgaben durchgeführt werden. Die Planungen für das Gesamtkonzept der neuen Wärmeversorgung sind in diesem Zusammenhang unterteilt in „Anlagentechnik zur Wärmegewinnung“, „Neubau einer Energiezentrale (Gebäude und Außenanlagen)“ und „Rohrleitung zur Anbindung an das Fernwärmenetz“. Die hier angefragte Leistung betrifft ausschließlich die Tragwerksplanung inkl. Planung Bauphysik für den „Neubau einer Energiezentrale (Gebäude)“. Die ENTEGA AG plant auf dem oben beschriebenem Grundstück den Neubau einer Energiezentrale zum Betrieb einer Wärmepumpenanlage. Das Baugrundstück mit einer Fläche von ca. 3282 m² befindet sich planungsrechtlich im Außenbereich. Das Gebäude mit ca. 930 m² BGF beinhaltet im Wesentlichen Technikräume zur Aufnahme der Anlagentechnik und einige weitere Funktionsräume, dauerhafte Arbeitsplätze sind nicht vorgesehen, die Anlage wird fernüberwacht. Die Gebäudeplanung ist im Auftragsfall in enger Abstimmung mit der Anlagenplanung für den gedachten Zweck zu optimieren. Das Gebäude ist prinzipiell in vier Zonen unterschiedlicher Nutzung unterteilt: -Wärmeerzeugung (Standort der Wärmepumpen) ca. 600 m² BGF. -Wärmeverteilung (Pumpen und Leitungsverteilungen) ca. 175 m² BGF -Stromübergabe und -Regelung (Trafo-Standort und Schaltanlagen) ca. 125 m² BGF -Nebenräume (WC, Lager, Büro) ca. 30 m² BGF Für den Auftraggeber ist es dabei von Bedeutung, dass unter Berücksichtigung einer wirtschaftlich optimierten Herangehensweise durch die Gestaltung des Gebäudes die besonderen Unternehmenswerte der ENTEGA AG - Innovation, Ökologie, Klimaneutralität, Effizienz und Nachhaltigkeit - angemessen zum Ausdruck gebracht werden. Dies soll insbesondere auch durch die verwendeten Baustoffe erfolgen. Die Unternehmenswerte Ökologie und Nachhaltigkeit sind auch bei der Planung der Freiflächen zugrunde zu legen, die in den Nutzflächenbereichen pflegeleicht und in begrünten Bereichen möglichst naturnah ausgeführt werden sollen. Angefragt werden die Grundleistungen der Tragwerksplanung, Leistungsbild nach HOAI §51, sowie die Grundleistungen der Bauphysik, Leistungsbild nach HOAI-Anlage 1.2. Leistungsumfang sind jeweils die Grundleistungen der HOAI-Leistungsphasen 2 bis 6, sowie optionale besondere Leistungen. Entsprechend den Leistungsphasen nach HOAI werden Arbeitspakete eingeteilt, die stufenweise im Sinne einer Erweiterung des Vertrages entsprechend § 315 BGB durch den AG beauftragt werden. Der AG beauftragt den AN mit Abschluss dieses Vertrages zunächst mit folgenden Leistungsphasen/Leistungsstufen: Stufe 1 – HOAI - Leistungsphasen 2 bis 4 Für die Weiterbeauftragung sind folgende Stufen vorgesehen: Stufe 2 – HOAI - Leistungsphase 5 Stufe 3 – HOAI - Leistungsphase 6 Die Stufen gelten gleichermaßen für Tragwerksplanung inkl. Planung Bauphysik. Der Auftraggeber macht an dieser Stelle darauf aufmerksam, dass für das Vorhaben in relevantem Umfang Fördermittel beantragt und erwartet werden. Der Prozess der Fördermittelbeantragung findet parallel zum Vergabevorhaben statt. Aus diesem Grund wird auf folgendes hingewiesen: Sollten die erwarteten Fördermittel nicht erteilt werden, wird der Auftraggeber von einem Vertragsschluss absehen und das Vorhaben nicht in der geplanten Form realisieren. Vor diesem Hintergrund wird im Fall der Nichterteilung der Fördermittel das laufende Vergabeverfahren aufgehoben werden. Aus der Beauftragung der ersten Stufe leitet sich keine Verpflichtung ab weitere Stufen zu beauftragen.
